annotations.title: サービスの一覧を見る

description: Use this when the user asks what services Ad Arch offers, or what information is needed before requesting a quote. Returns the request types Ad Arch accepts (filming, video production, YouTube, social media, TVer ads, other ad media, design, websites, events, other creative work, other) with the items to confirm before a quote for each type, and the service packages Ad Arch has published, with the deliverables and typical lead time of each (this list can be empty). Optional `category` filters the service packages only (e.g. 制作 / TVer / SNS / 採用). Does not return prices.

category.description: Text to filter the service packages by category (e.g. 制作 / TVer / SNS / 採用).

role.description: The user's position: company = a business commissioning production or advertising / creator = a videographer, editor or other creator / agency = an advertising agency or production company.

name: list_services

error.description: Reason the request could not be answered, in Japanese.

message.description: Message for the user, in Japanese.

needRole.description: true when the call was made without `role`; nothing else is returned.

notAvailable.description: true when the tool is not available for the given role.

note.description: Notes that apply to the result, in Japanese.

requestKinds.description: Request types accepted, with the items to confirm before a quote.

services.description: Published service packages. Can be empty.
